passive.name: King's Tribute
passive.description: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

primaryAbilities.name: Chomp
primaryAbilities.description: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Trundle's next Attack deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and briefly <status>Slows</status> by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, then Trundle gains <physicalDamage>{{ bonusad }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for {{ sapdebuffduration }} seconds and the enemy loses <physicalDamage>{{ sappedad*-1 }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for the same duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Frozen Domain
primaryAbilities.description: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Trundle freezes an area for {{ duration }} seconds. While inside he gains <speed>{{ msbonus*100 }}% Move Speed</speed>, <attackSpeed>{{ asbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, and {{ healingbonus*100 }}% increased healing.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Pillar of Ice
primaryAbilities.description: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Trundle creates an icy pillar for {{ pillarduration }} seconds, briefly <status>Knocking Back</status> enemies directly over it and <status>Slowing</status> nearby enemies by {{ slowamount }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Subjugate
primaryAbilities.description: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totalpercenthpdamage }} max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and stealing <scaleArmor>{{ armormrshred*100 }}% Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> over {{ actualdurationofdrainbuff }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
